reason: FR-01 spec requires (a) DELETE with admin scope on an existing task succeeds (currently only 403/404 paths tested, no positive 2xx assertion), (b) DELETE cascades to task_results in the same transaction (no assertion checks result-row removal), and (c) default limit is 50 (no test calls GET /v1/tasks without limit and asserts the default). Validation rules, 404 paths, 422 over-limit, cursor-disjoint, and GET-by-id fields all map to clear assertions.

gaps.message: No assertion tests DELETE /v1/tasks/{id} with admin scope on an existing task returning 2xx; only the negative non-admin→403 and admin+unknown→404 paths are checked. An implementation that500s on a valid admin delete would not be caught.

FR-01 requires DELETE to remove task_results in the same transaction, but no assertion verifies cascading delete. test_fr01_service_delete_task_returns_true_for_existing only checks the boolean return; an implementation leaving orphaned result rows would still pass.

Spec states default limit is 50, but no test calls GET /v1/tasks without the limit parameter and asserts the response honours the default. test_fr01_list_pagination_cursor_consistent explicitly passes limit=50.

test_fr01_repository_maybe_seed_inner_check_returns exercises internal stub internals (_seeded, _lock, _maybe_seed_synthetic, _store) and double-checked-locking seeding that the FR-01 spec does not require; this is an implementation-level test, not a spec assertion.
?status= filter is asserted only at the repository layer (test_fr01_repository_fetch_tasks_page_filters_by_status); no HTTP-level GET /v1/tasks?status=pending assertion verifies the wire contract.
Spec boundary limit=200 is never asserted to succeed (only limit=201→422). A defect capping max at 100 would not be caught.
